text: Skip to Main Content Screen Reader English More Home My Aadhaar About UIDAI Build with Us Media Documents Help Home / Build With Us / Offline Verification Seeking Entities Offline Verification Seeking Entity(OVSE) Offline verification refers to the framework that enables entities to perform Offline Verification of Aadhaar number holder for identity verification without connecting to the UIDAI’s CIDR (Central Identity Data Repository) . It allows secure, consent-based, and offline identity verification. Prominent Use Cases for Entities for Offline Verification 1. Hospitality and Tourism 2. Healthcare 3. Gig Economy 4. Entertainment & Public Events 5. Real Estate and Housing 6. Education 7. Recruitment 8. Facility Management 9. NGO and Trusts 10. Central and State Government departments 11. Fin tech Companies 12. Pilgrims Verification 13. Social/Community/Matchmaking 14. Or any other entity requiring Aadhaar offline verification Technical Requirement to become an OVSE Logo in SVG format (<10Kb)* A call back URL where UIDAI will post the response data* Organization Name to be displayed in Aadhaar App* Domain Name for verification* Class 3 or 2, Public Certificate with 2 Year Validity* Application ID - Android/iOS (App to App intent call)# * Mandatory Requirements # Conditional Requirement (mandatory only in app-to-app intent cal) Benefits of becoming a registered OVSE Option to verify complete or selective Aadhaar verified credentials Quick & seamless integration with Aadhaar application Improved efficiency and reduced operational costs Secure offline verification with savable output Proof-of-presence with offline face verification Lower compliance burden Instructions to Entities applying for OVSE Registration Entities seeking registration as an Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE) to perform offline verification of Aadhaar number holder for lawful purpose may apply to the Authority in the prescribed application form. For Any Clarification/support reach out to: ovse[dot]registration[at]uidai[dot]net[dot]in Click here: to read the Aadhaar (Authentication and Offline Verification) Regulations, 2021 (as amended in 2025).
